---
name: Bug report
about: Report something that didn't work as expected in a skill or in the docs
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

**Skill or file**
Which skill (e.g. `bug-report-writer`) or document is affected?

**AI tool**
Which agent/tool did you use (Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, Gemini…) and, if relevant, which MCP servers were connected?

**What you asked**
The prompt or input you gave (remove any real customer data or secrets).

**What you expected**

**What happened**
Paste the relevant part of the output or the error.

**Anything else**
Screenshots, language preference (`.qa-skills.yaml`), ideas for a fix…
